attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc, recursively chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files (owner rw, group r, no access for others). Original data (records.csv, config.json) preserved byte-for-byte. Completed mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id + permissions + data), rebooted node1 natively, confirmed connection loss during reboot, polled until reachable again, verified boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership/permissions/data intact post-restart.
